bank_complaint.en:
SUBJECT: Unauthorised online card transaction of ₹40,000 on 13 Nov 2026: request for reversal

DESCRIPTION:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am [YOUR FULL NAME], a Sahyog Bank customer. My card ending [CARD LAST 4 DIGITS] was charged ₹40,000 on 13 Nov 2026 for an online transaction on a gaming website. I did not make or authorise this transaction.

I reported it to the bank verbally on 18 Nov 2026. That was within three working days. I have had no response so far. I am now putting my complaint in writing.

Under the RBI circular RBI/2017-18/15 on customer liability, my liability for this transaction is zero. It was reported within three working days. The bank must credit ₹40,000 back to my account (a shadow credit) within 10 working days of my report, that is, by 1 Dec 2026.

I am aware of the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026. I am making this written complaint as the first step under it.

Thank you.

[YOUR FULL NAME]
[REGISTERED MOBILE NUMBER]
[REGISTERED EMAIL ADDRESS]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Treat the ₹40,000 transaction of 13 Nov 2026 as unauthorised.
2. Credit ₹40,000 back to my account (shadow credit) by 1 Dec 2026.
3. Block the card if not already done, and issue a replacement.
4. Give me a written complaint reference number and inform me of the outcome in writing.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Card statement showing the ₹40,000 transaction
- Transaction alert SMS or email, with date and time
- Note of verbal complaint on 18 Nov 2026 (date, time, number called, any reference given: [VERBAL COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER])
- Copy of ID proof, if the bank asks for it
bank_complaint.hi:
SUBJECT: सहयोग बैंक कार्ड पर ₹40,000 के अनधिकृत ऑनलाइन लेनदेन की लिखित शिकायत

DESCRIPTION:
महोदय/महोदया,

मेरा नाम [YOUR FULL NAME] है। मेरे सहयोग बैंक कार्ड (अंतिम 4 अंक: [CARD LAST 4 DIGITS]) से 13 Nov 2026 को एक गेमिंग वेबसाइट पर ₹40,000 का ऑनलाइन लेनदेन हुआ। यह लेनदेन मैंने नहीं किया और न ही इसकी अनुमति दी।

मैंने 18 Nov 2026 को बैंक को मौखिक रूप से इसकी सूचना दी थी। अब तक बैंक से कोई जवाब नहीं मिला है। इसलिए मैं यह शिकायत लिखित रूप में दे रहा/रही हूँ।

RBI circular RBI/2017-18/15 on customer liability के अनुसार, अगर धोखाधड़ी किसी और ने की है और ग्राहक 3 कार्य दिवसों के भीतर सूचना दे, तो ग्राहक की देनदारी शून्य होती है। मैंने तीसरे कार्य दिवस पर सूचना दी थी। इसलिए मेरी देनदारी शून्य है। पूरी राशि ₹40,000 मेरे खाते में "शैडो क्रेडिट" के रूप में 1 Dec 2026 तक वापस आनी चाहिए। यह मेरी सूचना के 10 कार्य दिवस बाद की तारीख है।

कृपया इस शिकायत का पंजीकरण करें और मुझे रेफरेंस नंबर दें। मैं RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026 के तहत यह लिखित शिकायत दर्ज कर रहा/रही हूँ।

धन्यवाद,
[YOUR FULL NAME]
[YOUR MOBILE NUMBER]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. इस लेनदेन को अनधिकृत मानकर ₹40,000 मेरे खाते में 1 Dec 2026 तक शैडो क्रेडिट करें।
2. मेरी देनदारी शून्य मानें।
3. अगर अभी तक कार्ड ब्लॉक नहीं हुआ है, तो उसे ब्लॉक करें और नया कार्ड जारी करें।
4. इस शिकायत का रेफरेंस नंबर और लिखित पावती दें।
5. जाँच का नतीजा मुझे लिखित में बताएँ।

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- कार्ड स्टेटमेंट, जिसमें ₹40,000 का लेनदेन दिख रहा हो
- बैंक का SMS या ईमेल अलर्ट (अगर मिला हो)
- 18 Nov 2026 की मौखिक शिकायत का विवरण (कॉल का समय या शाखा का नाम)
- पहचान पत्र की प्रति

consumer_commission.en:
SUBJECT: Complaint against Sahyog Bank for an unauthorised ₹40,000 online card transaction

DESCRIPTION:
I am [YOUR FULL NAME], a customer of Sahyog Bank. My card ending [CARD LAST 4 DIGITS] is linked to my savings account ending [ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS].

On 13 Nov 2026, ₹40,000 was charged to my card for an online payment on a gaming website. I did not make this transaction.

On 18 Nov 2026, I reported it to the bank verbally at [BRANCH NAME OR PHONE NUMBER]. The bank has not responded.

Under the RBI circular RBI/2017-18/15 on customer liability, I have zero liability. The fraud was not my doing, and I reported it within 3 working days. The bank must credit ₹40,000 back to me by 1 Dec 2026, 10 working days after my report.

This complaint is within the 2-year limit under the Consumer Protection Act 2019, section 69. Under the Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction) Rules 2021, G.S.R. 912(E), this District Commission can hear it, as the amount is below ₹50 lakh. Under the Consumer commission filing-fee notification G.S.R. 606(E), 2023, the filing fee is nil.

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Direct Sahyog Bank to credit back ₹40,000 to my card or account.
2. Direct the bank to reverse any interest, fees or charges on this amount.
3. Grant any other relief the Commission considers fair.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Card statement showing the ₹40,000 charge
- Bank alert SMS or email for the transaction
- Proof of my 18 Nov 2026 report (call log or branch details)
- Any later messages from the bank
- My ID and address proof

rbi_ombudsman.en:
SUBJECT: Unauthorised ₹40,000 online card transaction on Sahyog Bank card: no reversal and no reply

DESCRIPTION:
I am [YOUR FULL NAME], a Sahyog Bank customer. My card ending [CARD LAST 4 DIGITS] was charged ₹40,000 on 13 Nov 2026 for a transaction on a gaming website. I did not make or authorise this transaction.

I reported it to Sahyog Bank verbally on 18 Nov 2026, within 3 working days. I also complained in writing on [DATE OF YOUR WRITTEN COMPLAINT TO THE BANK], reference [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER]. As of [DATE OF FILING], the bank has not replied, and the ₹40,000 has not been credited back.

Under RBI circular RBI/2017-18/15 on customer liability, I lose nothing because I reported within 3 working days and the fraud was not my doing. My liability is zero. The bank should have given a shadow credit of ₹40,000 by 1 Dec 2026, 10 working days after my report.

I am filing within the time allowed under the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026. This matter is not before any court, tribunal, arbitrator or other Ombudsman. I am filing it myself, not through a lawyer.

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Direct Sahyog Bank to reverse the ₹40,000 unauthorised charge in full.
2. Direct the bank to reverse any interest, fees or charges levied on this amount.
3. Award compensation the Ombudsman considers fair for my lost time, expenses and harassment.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Card statement showing the ₹40,000 charge on 13 Nov 2026
- Bank alert (SMS/email) for the transaction
- Copy of my written complaint to Sahyog Bank and proof of sending
- Notes of my verbal complaint on 18 Nov 2026 (call time, number called)
- Any bank reply, or a note that none was received
